messages:
Ivy (PM): Quick thread: customers want an upgrade flow that preserves their public/egress footprint and supports small airgap patches. Need acceptance criteria and a short runbook.
Sam (Eng): We can do a delta bundle (signed manifest + patches) and a migration runner that supports dry-run + resume. Key is reversible migrations and checksum validation.
Rae (Eng-Infra): Network constraints: we'll guarantee LB VIPs and NAT ranges only. Pod IPs are ephemeral. Suggest a boolean flag `preserve-egress=true` in installer and a preflight that returns PASS/FAIL.
Owen (Field): On the ground: NetOps wants a one-page checklist (VIP list, firewall ports, bastion access) and an explicit customer-approve step before apply.
Dana (SRE): Rollback plan: cache previous bundle for 72h, store applied migration id in control DB, auto-revert on health-check failure unless customer opts out. Emit clear alerts with remediation links.
Sam (Eng): CLI sketch:
`redwood delta verify ./bundle.tgz`
`redwood delta plan ./bundle.tgz --preserve-egress`
`redwood delta apply ./bundle.tgz --customer-approve`
Rae (Eng-Infra): Preflight JSON output for programmatic gating e.g. `{ "vip_ok": "true", "egress_conflicts": [] }` (we'll obfuscate IPs in telemetry).
Ivy (PM): Prioritize MVP: manifest schema + CLI verify/plan + preflight PASS/FAIL + 1-page NetOps runbook. Stretch: console preview and network-shadow simulator.
Owen (Field): I'll pilot with two customers and draft the runbook template.
deploy-bot: Ticket PRD-1420 created: "Egress-preserve delta upgrades" (owner: Ivy).
Dana (SRE): Also recommend telemetry opt-in for upgrade events (duration/success) to tune SLOs.
Ivy (PM): Action items: Sam -> manifest validator spike by Fri; Rae -> preflight prototype by Fri; Owen -> runbook draft by Mon; Dana -> rollback playbook by Fri. Sync next Tue 30m to lock launch gate.
